title: AuthLogoutResult
description: The launcher's session for a stack, ended. Desktop's own session is not touched.

key.description: The stack's key in the sign-in store. Absent when no stack is recorded.

wasSignedIn.description: Whether a session was stored. false: nothing was done.

revoked.description: Whether the issuer revoked the session's refresh token. false with wasSignedIn: the local token is forgotten, and the refresh token stays valid at the issuer until it expires.
